assignment.scope: Internal executable work plan only. No quantity policy, code, product acceptance or project contract is adopted by this register.

authority_boundary.goal: Full CSI Division 23, all actual sections/subsections and their complete source-backed taxonomy, connected on Mac and Windows.
authority_boundary.current_inventory: 52 UFGS guide entries from the August 2026 public TOC plus 4 individually verified VA guides. These are separate authority-qualified records, not 56 CSI leaves.
authority_boundary.reason_no_percentage: A complete authoritative edition-specific CSI denominator and its reconciliation are not available.
authority_boundary.parentage: Only the supported Division 23 parent is recorded. Agency decimal and service suffixes remain intact; lexical prefixes, substitutions, and related-work citations are not inferred CSI children.
authority_boundary.hypothetical_number: The owner's 23.02.01 example illustrates required granularity; it is not admitted as a real section.
authority_boundary.project_vs_product: A sourced project not-applicable decision affects that project revision only. It cannot close product support for a section/taxon.
authority_boundary.guide_vs_project: Guide text, including unbracketed provisions, is not automatically an adopted project obligation. Options, writer notes, alternatives and unresolved references remain visible.

counts.counts_meaning: Counts describe the source-qualified section register only; task count does not establish full CSI coverage or completed taxonomy.

next_ready_task.parallel_ready_support: Catalogue reconciliation and section tasks proceed against actual prerequisites; no special hydronic priority or permanent worked-example deliverable.

steps: Check the authorized source when available and pin edition, source identity and permitted use.

stage_contract_semantics.instantiation: Every section tasks[stage] object is a concrete task. Its full objective is stage_contracts[stage].objective applied to that section's exact number/title and planning_subject; its deliverable and end conditions are the shared contract bound to the stated artifact. No 448 copied generic task bodies are necessary.
stage_contract_semantics.dependency_semantics: A stage task dependency means its relevant taxon output, not completion of the predecessor for every taxon/section. A missing input blocks only the dependent calculation or acceptance claim. Conditional dependencies apply only to the stated behavior.
stage_contract_semantics.taxon_instantiation: Each reviewed leaf gets the same eight stage contracts using its taxon ID prefix. Split combined records when source variants require independent evidence; no leaf is complete merely because its task exists.
stage_contract_semantics.artifact_paths: All artifact paths are planned outputs, not assertions that those files already exist. Code/test write paths must be assigned by the coordinator before each bounded implementation dispatch; no worker owns shared implementation paths by this register.
stage_contract_semantics.acceptance_definition: Bind stage end conditions to declared taxon scope, exact sources/fixtures, independent expected results and numerical thresholds before the relevant run. An undefined gate remains acceptance_definition_pending.

TAX.name: Source-backed taxonomy
TAX.objective: Enumerate the entire source section and its supported internal hierarchy
TAX.deliverable: A paragraph-to-taxon inventory with source spans, types/subtypes, service/material/size/joint attributes, relationships, referenced scope, exclusions, options and service obligations.
dependencies: Verified section identity; retrieve and pin the full applicable guide/specification text. A table-of-contents title is not the body.
For project applicability, obtain the exact project-adopted edition/revision; guide taxonomy preparation can proceed now.
end_condition: Every source part/paragraph has a reviewed disposition: taxon/attribute/relationship/reference/obligation/exclusion/option or explicitly justified non-scope text.
Each taxon has a stable ID, exact source locator and dimensional domain; unsupported branches, unread references and contradictory clauses remain named UNKNOWN work.
No invented CSI children or unsourced Cartesian combinations of material, service, size and joint.
Taxon-level tasks, exact expected outputs and remaining decisions are instantiated. Completion of this stage does not close the section.
A single-guide source audit may close independently; complete section TAX additionally requires a frozen complete declared scope/evidence set and resolution of its required taxon/child coverage gaps.

EVID.name: Drawing, schedule and specification producers
EVID.objective: Connect original-source evidence producers for every admitted taxon
EVID.deliverable: Source-bound drawing geometry, schedule cells, specification clauses and manual review records with IDs, role, revision, page/region and unresolved evidence states.
dependencies: Only the relevant taxon's TAX identity/attributes are required; other taxons need not wait.
Approved or public fixture documents with known provenance; original sources for any automated recognition acceptance.
Route scale/elevations only for measured taxons; counts and written obligations have no blanket scale prerequisite.
end_condition: Each taxon has a positive source example and an omitted/ambiguous/conflicting example with expected reviewed output.
Automated producer claims are tested on original drawing/specification inputs, not only manually injected detections.
Unknown identity, unmeasured routes, unread clauses and referenced-but-unsupplied documents produce visible unresolved records rather than zero.
Evidence can be opened from the connected workspace with exact source identity.

RULE.name: Approved counting and measuring boundaries
RULE.objective: Bind reviewed rules and adjudicated examples to the section's taxons
RULE.deliverable: An exact-hash rule packet, worked examples, exclusions/precedence decisions and owner-decision receipt per required new quantity behavior.
dependencies: Relevant TAX types and project scope choices, including guide options and responsibility boundaries.
New calculation boundaries need an owner decision; reuse unchanged approved equipment E01–E12/EC01–EC20 where applicable.
Rule preparation does not wait for full recognition or for other Division 23 sections.
end_condition: Every taxon is assigned an approved quantity basis or a documented non-quantity obligation output.
Count/measure basis, imperial units, work status, inclusions/exclusions, package membership and unknown handling have explicit examples.
Missing length/size/service or unchosen options never acquire default values or zero quantities.

Existing approved rules are hash-bound and reused. Examples introducing or changing quantity policy require an actual owner decision before quantity authority; additional fixtures under unchanged approved rules use independently established expected results and engineering verification.

CALC.name: Deterministic connected quantities
CALC.objective: Deliver deterministic quantity and obligation projections through the workspace
CALC.deliverable: A connected calculation/result contract with exact evidence/rule provenance and focused golden-case results for the section.
dependencies: Relevant EVID records and approved RULE inputs, not completion of unrelated taxons.
Current scale/dimension/elevation evidence for measured amounts; assembly membership and responsibility for procurement/installation projections.
For service or reference taxons, an obligation projection is the deliverable; do not invent material counts.
end_condition: Replaying exact source/rule inputs yields identical physical, package, installation and obligation results.
Every result contains source IDs, rule IDs, units and known/unresolved status; totals never silently absorb unknowns.
The connected app shows taxon rows and totals, including partial known amounts and unresolved components.
Adjudicated positive, exclusion, duplicate, missing-data and revision cases match exact expected values.

RECON.name: Requirements, assemblies and responsibility
RECON.objective: Reconcile written scope with physical evidence, packages and responsible parties
RECON.deliverable: Source-linked requirement/evidence/assembly crosslinks with supply, installation, trade/interface and reference-resolution states.
dependencies: Relevant TAX nodes and applicable source clauses; these may be linked before final quantities exist.
Physical identity evidence only for crosslinks that assert a particular instance; actual package/supply data only for those responsibility decisions.
end_condition: Each scoped requirement is satisfied by exact linked evidence, explicitly excluded by a sourced decision, or an actionable UNKNOWN obligation.
Schedule rows, plan appearances, internal package parts and referenced requirements are linked without duplicate purchases.
Supply, installation, low-voltage/line-power responsibility and service coverage remain separate when applicable.
A cross-reference never proves that the referenced section was supplied or fully supported.

EDIT.name: Corrections, revisions and reopen
EDIT.objective: Carry corrections and changed source/rule identities through taxon results and history
EDIT.deliverable: Append-only correction/revision/reopen evidence showing affected taxon records, regenerated quantities and retained prior states.
dependencies: The affected EVID/requirement records exist; CALC is required only to verify recalculated numeric outputs.
Exact changed source, taxon, assembly or rule identities; unchanged accepted inputs reuse existing evidence.
end_condition: Correcting identity/service/material/size/joint/geometry/option/responsibility updates only affected results.
Revised source/rule bytes make dependent decisions stale, retain history and require their proper re-review.
Save, close and reopen preserve current output and prior decisions without silent approval or double counting.
Unchanged sibling taxons/sections retain valid results; no wholesale restart.

conditional_dependency_stages.when: The edit changes a requirement, package or responsibility crosslink.

OUT.name: Excel and source-linked evidence outputs
OUT.objective: Export the section's current quantities, obligations, unknowns and audit trail
OUT.deliverable: An Excel specimen, consolidated evidence PDF and machine-readable output comparison tied to the same section/taxon/rule/source identities.
dependencies: Current EVID/RECON records can export written requirements before every host quantity exists.
CALC results are needed only for the quantities exported; existing export infrastructure is reused where applicable.
end_condition: Excel rows/totals and evidence PDF agree exactly with connected core results and separate physical/package/installation/service records.
Each output preserves taxon ID, source location, rule identity, applicability, UNKNOWN/stale status and responsibility.
Fixtures include known-plus-unknown partial results, project-not-applicable decisions and cross-section assemblies.
A source link opens the exact supporting page/region or clause after reopen.

conditional_dependency_stages.when: The exported taxon emits numeric quantities.

ACCEPT.name: Section fixtures and Mac engineering acceptance
ACCEPT.objective: Accept complete taxon coverage and the connected section against exact source/code bytes
ACCEPT.deliverable: An estimator-adjudicated case matrix and independent acceptance dossier with original-source results, export checks and current Mac workflow evidence. Record platform scope as Mac; Windows delivery remains a separate deferred task.
dependencies: All relevant taxon-stage end conditions are satisfied; justified non-quantity stage variants are recorded, not silently skipped.
Representative section fixtures and estimator expectations with explicit omission/quantity tolerances.
Current Mac workflow execution against exact candidate bytes and original-source representative evidence. Windows delivery is not a dependency of this section task.
end_condition: Every declared taxon/variant has an accepted positive case plus applicable missing/conflict/exclusion/revision/assembly cases; expected results and tolerances are adjudicated.
Every source paragraph and outstanding reference/UNKNOWN is reconciled or remains an explicit product limitation; unresolved taxonomy coverage prevents complete section acceptance.
Connected import/read/review/calculate/correct/reopen/export passes on Mac for the recorded identities; this closes the Mac engineering scope without claiming Windows verification.
The independent reviewer accepts the section dossier; shared helpers and another project's not-applicable result do not close any taxon.

Representative expectations, omission limits, numeric measurement/recognition thresholds and required platform workflows are frozen before execution. Missing definitions have state acceptance_definition_pending; new targets cannot be chosen after results.

dimensions: physical versus package versus installation versus service output
project applicability and adopted rule identity

unknown_obligation.rule: An unread reference, unchosen guide option, missing host or unshown field-work extent becomes a visible UNKNOWN obligation. It is never dropped, converted to zero, or satisfied by an unrelated shared component.

taxonomy_record_contract.no_double_counting: One physical object retains one source-bound identity even when drawn, scheduled, specified or included in an assembly more than once. Procurement, installation, internal parts, temporary work, consumables, services and deliverables have explicit relationships and distinct outputs. Quantity equivalence does not establish identity.
taxonomy_record_contract.no_cartesian_defaults: Record only source-supported combinations and predicates; do not fabricate every service × material × size × joint combination or infer numeric allowances from guide titles.

conditions: Exact type/subtype/attribute domain and source/edition/application predicates are reviewed, including alternatives, exclusions and references.
Relevant original-source producer, approved rule/obligation projection, deterministic connected result, crosslinks, corrections/reopen and Excel/evidence-PDF outputs satisfy their stage contracts.

Representative estimator-adjudicated positive and missing/conflict/exclusion/revision/assembly cases cover that taxon's supported variants; original-source recognition has its own evidence when claimed.

Exact-byte current Mac workflow evidence plus independent acceptance are present; unknown taxonomy branches or unaccepted required mechanical behavior prevent taxon engineering closure. Windows delivery is a separate task, not this endpoint's prerequisite.

Frozen expected results, tolerances, commands and evidence pass with zero unexplained omissions and no failed/skipped mandatory check; independently accepted supporting work is not reopened by unrelated feature suggestions.
taxon_completion_contract.nonphysical_variant: Service, reference and deliverable taxons close through source-linked obligation/responsibility/document behavior and applicable tests. A recorded non-numeric output is valid; absence of a material count is not permission to omit the taxon.
taxon_completion_contract.not_applicable: Project-specific not-applicable must cite project evidence and never changes product completion.

conditions: Every source part/paragraph/subparagraph has a reviewed disposition and complete normalized taxonomy; all declared leaf taxons meet their own completion endpoint.
All applicable physical and nonphysical outputs are connected, with requirements/assembly/responsibility links and no duplicate procurement.
Changes, revisions, stale rules, history/reopen, Excel and evidence PDF pass section-specific tests.

Representative estimator and original-source acceptance plus current Mac workflow results are accepted against exact candidate identities. Record the section as engineering-accepted on Mac; deferred Windows delivery does not block this endpoint.

A known-guide section may be accepted for its explicit dated source boundary independently; claiming full CSI Division 23 additionally requires D23-CSI-CATALOGUE-1 and closure of every actual reconciled section/subsection.

preserve_accepted: accepted duct calculation/topology and source-linked Excel
approved air-device rules/software with recognition limits retained

equipment.behavior: Retain existing authorization and exact hashes; map only applicable equipment taxons to this engine, do not restart rules or claim section closure.

shared_support.independence: No task here depends on duct or air-device acceptance unless a recorded exact input of that task actually requires it. Catalogue/recognition/provider/native limitations do not block independent taxonomy or specification-obligation work.

acceptance_contract.definition: Acceptance is a recorded pass against a frozen contract. An authorized supporting engineering task closes when all mandatory criteria pass and independent Codex review accepts its exact bytes; whole-section/product gates are separate.
mandatory_fields: independent expected results for named cases
exact commands or bounded manual procedure
acceptance_contract.pass_fail: Every mandatory check named in this task's fixed contract must pass, including zero unexplained omissions from its declared coverage set. Skipped or unavailable required checks remain open. An expected UNKNOWN or explicitly recorded source conflict can satisfy its named check; unrelated unfinished tasks do not block this task. A new feature or stricter target is a new task or explicitly versioned contract, not indefinite re-review.
acceptance_contract.recognition: Freeze numerical per-class precision/recall, applicable geometry/error tolerances and permitted review burden before any benchmark. This plan does not invent those values; an undefined threshold blocks that benchmark gate, not independent preparation.
acceptance_contract.whole_section: Complete declared taxonomy and every required child/taxon/stage must close with frozen representative expectations and exact-byte Mac workflow evidence. Windows delivery is separate and deferred. A source audit is supporting work only.
acceptance_contract.platform_priority: Owner reaffirmed Mac first on 2026-09-16. Current section/taxon engineering acceptance is Mac-scoped; WINDOWS-DELIVERY-1 is not a prerequisite. Final product delivery retains both platforms.
